name: Woolman-Groet-Miller Endowment Fund grants
summary: Standing grant fund of a local Audubon chapter for specific conservation and environmental education projects such as plantings and prairie seeding, with priority for St. Joseph and Elkhart Counties in Indiana.

applicant_types.quote: Organizations eligible to receive grants from the WGM Fund include schools, government agencies such as state and county parks, and 501(c)3 (not-for-profit) organizations whose missions are environment-, education- or conservation-oriented.

access.quote: The Society is interested in learning of worthwhile environmental and conservation programs and invites proposals from the community.
